d: At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Inbound Marketer to build scalable inbound marketing systems that generate qualified pipeline through content, SEO, and conversion optimization.
This is far more than a traditional SEO role.

You’ll create high-quality content, improve search visibility, develop lead magnets, optimize conversion paths, and distribute content across the right channels to drive awareness, demand, and measurable business growth.
You’ll work closely with leadership and marketing teams to build inbound engines that turn content into qualified leads—not just traffic.
If you understand how search, content, buyer psychology, and conversion work together, and enjoy creating marketing assets that generate real business results, this role is a strong fit.
q: Excellent written English and storytelling skills.
Portfolio showcasing inbound or SEO-driven content.
Experience building and promoting lead magnets.
Experience improving website conversion rates and inbound lead generation.
What a Typical Day Looks Like
Write and optimize blogs, landing pages, and website content.
Research search trends, competitors, and keyword opportunities.
Build lead magnets and conversion-focused assets.
Review SEO and content performance data.
Optimize existing content based on rankings and analytics.
Collaborate with marketing teams on inbound campaigns.
Improve inbound funnels and content distribution strategies.
In short: You’ll build inbound marketing systems that turn valuable content, search visibility, and conversion optimization into qualified pipeline and measurable business growth.
Improved keyword rankings and search visibility.
Landing page and lead magnet conversion rates.
Engagement and performance of inbound content.
Consistent execution of high-quality inbound campaigns.
Direct ownership of inbound marketing strategy and execution.
Opportunity to build scalable content and demand generation systems.
Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience with inbound marketing, SEO, content creation, lead generation, and conversion optimization. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight campaigns you’ve worked on, how you’ve improved organic growth, and how you’ve used AI tools to enhance content creation, research, and marketing workflows. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the practical assessment and client interview.
You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.
Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

If you’re passionate about building inbound marketing systems, creating high-impact content, and turning search traffic into qualified pipeline, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive measurable business growth through modern inbound marketing.
r: Create high-quality, value-driven content that educates prospects and builds authority.
Develop content aligned with search intent, buyer journey stages, and conversion goals.
Continuously improve existing content based on rankings and performance data.
Collaborate on website and landing page optimization initiatives.
Improve conversion rates through stronger messaging and positioning.
Identify content gaps and inbound growth opportunities.
Develop compelling content ideas backed by research.
Optimize content based on measurable performance.
Provide recommendations that improve inbound marketing results.
Consistent growth in qualified inbound leads.
Higher organic search visibility and rankings.
Increased landing page and lead magnet conversion rates.
Strong contribution to pipeline from inbound channels.
Consistent delivery of high-quality inbound marketing initiatives.
What Makes You a Strong Fit
You understand that inbound marketing creates demand—not just content.
You write content that educates, engages, and converts.
You understand SEO, AI-powered search, and modern buyer behavior.
You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
You continuously improve performance using analytics and data.
You stay organized while managing multiple marketing initiatives.

d: Century Financial is one of the UAE’s pioneering financial services company specializing in investments and trading in financial instruments like currencies, indices, shares, commodities, treasuries, and ETFs, along with exchange-traded derivatives.

As a Relationship Manager, one needs to have an exceptional understanding of the financial markets and track competition closely to stay ahead of the curve. Constantly strive to find innovative solutions to onboard new clients with the organization and ensure their healthy equity balances.
Responsible for acquiring preferred HNI & UHNI clients.
Look to always enhance his/her Capital Markets Knowledge through continuous self-learning and training provided by the company.
Ensure that allocated clients are introduced/contacted regularly and managed effectively via telephone or in-person in such a way as to justify the value of the “Premium” service.
Proactive attitude of growing the client base through existing client network via referral.
Conduct detailed risk assessment and suitability assessment of clients and offer products that are aligned to the client’s risk profile.

Proactively and frequently entertaining clients (and prospects) at various events and meetings, which will include “out-of-hours” commitment on evenings and weekends, as part of your relationship management expectations.
Understand and specify the needs and preferences of high-value clients and offer tailored support.
Liaise with other members of client-facing teams to ensure a high standard of client services.
Driving business acquisition through reference, networking, and channel partnership.
Formulate sales plans to acquire new HNI customers for increasing customer base.
Conduct risk profiling of all mapped clients for better advisory on investment and trading requirements.
Ensuring need-based product approach towards clients.
Comply with the established companies ‘Ethics & Code of Conduct’ policies.
q: Over 5 years of Sales experience in Financial/ Banking/ Insurance industry.
Excellent knowledge and experience of financial markets
CISI and SCA Certification are desirable but not mandatory, eventually all candidates will be required to have them after joining.

d: Provide Performance Management and Talent Management support services across the organization, acting as an accountable resource for the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of performance and talent processes.

Organizes and controls end-to-end performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, KPI frameworks, and calibration, ensuring clarity of individual contributions and alignment with corporate objectives.

Supports wider Talent Management initiatives, including Learning & Development, Competency Assurance, Succession Planning, and Talent Reviews, to strengthen organizational capability and leadership pipeline.
Ensures alignment of performance outcomes with rewards, development, and workforce planning, contributing to building a high-performance culture and long-term business sustainability.
The position operates in accordance with organizational strategy, policies, governance standards, and best international HR practices.
q: Bachelor’s degree in human resource, Administration, or related field
(preferred) Oil & Energy experience (greenfield petrochemical plant operations and infrastructure)
Experience with various HR functions, including:
Detailed-oriented with excellent organizing and planning skills.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relations with people in a multi-cultural environment
Ability to work on own initiative
Ability to be flexible, motivated, resourceful, and organized to work in a multi-functional role
Builds expert knowledge in our organization and conveys knowledge to others
Computer literate with expertise in MS Office.
r: Organizes and controls the end-to-end performance management cycle, including goal setting, mid-year reviews, annual appraisals, and calibration processes in line with the approved performance management framework.
Plans and executes implementation of performance frameworks (KPIs/OKRs), ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and business objectives.
Ensures clarity, consistency, and fairness in performance evaluations across departments.
Facilitates performance calibration sessions to ensure equitable rating distributions and objectivity.
Develops and maintains performance management policies, guidelines, reports and tools.
Supports the cascading of corporate objectives into departmental and individual goals.
Monitors quality of goal setting and ensures alignment with strategic priorities.
Analyzes performance data and produces reports, dashboards, and insights for leadership decision-making.
Identifies trends, gaps, and risks in workforce performance and recommends improvement actions.
Provides guidance and coaching to managers on effective performance management, feedback conversations, and handling underperformance.
Supports development and tracking of Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).
Promote continuous improvement of the performance management cycle through periodic reviews, stakeholder feedback, and adoption of best practices to enhance process efficiency and effectiveness.
Supports Talent Review processes, including identification of high-potential employees and critical roles.
Contributes to the design and execution of Succession Planning frameworks and talent pipelines.
Collaborates with Learning & Development to align performance outcomes with development plans.
Assists in competency framework design, assessment, and gap analysis.
Supports leadership development and capability-building initiatives.
Manages performance management systems (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, Workday) ensuring data integrity and user adoption.
Ensures compliance with internal policies, audit requirements, and applicable regulations.
